jobs.title: Semaphore: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Novi Sad
URL: https://semaphore.io/

About Semaphore

Semaphore is a remote-first software company building continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) products for engineering teams. Our customers rely on Semaphore Cloud and our self-hosted enterprise products to build, test, and deliver software securely and reliably.


We have spent years building developer infrastructure at scale. We are now using that foundation to create new products and capabilities for a world in which software is increasingly built by people working with AI coding agents.


About the role

We are looking for a senior product engineer who can take an important idea from an early, ambiguous problem to a useful product running in production.

You will work across product and engineering boundaries: understanding the user, shaping the solution, making technical decisions, building the system, and improving it based on real use. Some work will extend mature Semaphore products. Some will start as a small experiment or a new product. In either case, you will be responsible for getting to a strong outcome, not completing a predefined list of tickets.


AI coding agents are part of our daily engineering workflow. We expect you to use them fluently to explore, build, test, and ship faster. You remain accountable for the work: choosing the right problem, setting direction, making trade-offs, reviewing what is produced, and ensuring that the result is coherent, reliable, and maintainable.


This role is for someone with strong ownership, initiative, taste, and judgment. You should be comfortable moving between product questions, system design, code, infrastructure, and user experience as the work requires.

What you will own

  • Take product ideas from problem definition through design, implementation, rollout, and iteration, including experiments that may grow into standalone products.
  • Work directly with users and internal stakeholders to identify the real problem, decide what is worth building, and make pragmatic scope and architecture decisions.
  • Build across backend services, APIs, infrastructure-facing components, and focused frontend experiences, reusing proven Semaphore systems before introducing new infrastructure.
  • Use AI coding agents effectively while maintaining a high bar for correctness, security, clarity, and product quality.
  • Own the production outcome, including reliability, observability, supportability, and working within Semaphore's security and compliance requirements. Communicate decisions, progress, and risks clearly.

What we are looking for

  • A track record of independently shipping meaningful software products or major product capabilities.
  • Strong product judgment: you can identify the essential user problem, reduce unnecessary scope, and recognize when an experience is good enough to ship—or not good enough yet.
  • Strong engineering judgment across system design, implementation, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Strong backend and systems fundamentals, including APIs, asynchronous processing, service boundaries, state and lifecycle management, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Comfort with infrastructure concepts such as virtual machines, storage, networking, authentication, secrets, containers, and cloud platforms.
  • Ability to navigate a polyglot environment. Semaphore systems include Go, Elixir, Ruby, React, and related technologies; expertise in every language is not required.
  • Enough frontend capability to build or extend focused product user experiences without depending on a separate team for every change.
  • Fluency with modern AI-assisted development: decomposing work for agents, supplying useful context, reviewing generated changes, and building verification into the workflow.
    Initiative and persistence. You make progress with incomplete information, surface risks early, and bring in other people when their input will improve the result.
  • Strong written and spoken English and experience working independently in a remote, asynchronous team.


We care more about the quality and ownership of what you have built than a specific number of years, previous title, or exact match with our stack.


Nice to have

  • Experience building developer tools, CI/CD systems, cloud platforms, or infrastructure products.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience evolving a mature codebase while introducing a new product or architecture alongside it.
  • Experience in a lean environment where senior engineers participate directly in product discovery and customer conversations.

What success looks like

Within your first three months:

  • You have taken ownership of a meaningful product problem and shipped a useful capability to production.
  • Your work shows good product taste, clear technical decisions, and disciplined scope.
  • You have learned enough of Semaphore's existing platform to reuse its strengths and avoid unnecessary reinvention.
  • You are using AI coding agents to increase your output while keeping the resulting systems understandable, tested, and reliable.
  • Product and engineering decisions move faster because you bring clear options, make sound calls, and follow through.
  • The team trusts you with an ambiguous new product or feature and expects you to drive it to a strong result.

How you will work

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad ownership. You will work closely with engineering, product, infrastructure, and company leadership. Teams are small, communication is direct, and the person closest to the work is expected to exercise judgment.


You will have room to shape both the product and its implementation. In return, we expect you to take responsibility for the whole outcome: what gets built, why it matters, how well it works, and what happens after it ships.

You won’t just be selling a platform; you will be partnering with CTOs, CIOs, and VPs of Engineering at the US’s most influential enterprises to redefine how they manage digital operations, resilience, and automation.

You will act as a bridge between our customers’ long-term strategic needs and PagerDuty’s product roadmap. You will spend your time evangelizing the PagerDuty Operations Cloud, mentoring our high-performing technical sales teams, and acting as a trusted advisor to the C-suite on topics ranging from AIOps and SRE maturity to digital transformation and cloud migration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a peer and advisor to customer CTOs and CIOs, helping them navigate complex digital transformations and operationalizing the PagerDuty Operations Cloud within their organizations.
  • Represent PagerDuty as a thought leader at major industry events and through digital content, white-papers, and local media.
  • Partner closely with our Global Product and Engineering leadership in San Francisco to ensure the unique requirements of the US markets are represented in our long-term roadmap.
  • Provide architectural oversight and executive presence for our most complex, high-stakes enterprise opportunities across the US.
  • Foster a local community of DevOps and SRE leaders, sharing best practices on operational excellence, incident response, and the ethical application of AI in operations.
  • Stay ahead of the curve on the competitive landscape, identifying market shifts and technical trends that PagerDuty can capitalize on.

Who You Are

  • You have a deep-seated passion for the future of digital operations. You can articulate not just where the industry is today, but where it will be in 3–5 years.
  • You are equally comfortable white-boarding a complex micro services architecture with a Lead Architect as you are presenting a business value case to a Board of Directors.
  • You have a strong technical foundation. You understand the "pains" of the modern developer because you’ve lived them.
  • You don’t just want to close deals; you want to ensure customers achieve their desired outcomes and see PagerDuty as a mission-critical partner.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in technical leadership, solutions architecture, or product management within the SaaS, DevOps, or Cloud infrastructure space.
  • Proven track record of engaging with and influencing C-level executives at Fortune 500 or equivalent global enterprises, navigating complex organizations.
  • Proven ability to support and influence sales cycles with a solid grasp of sales processes and customer buying journeys
  • Deep domain expertise in at least three of the following: Incident Management, SRE (Site Reliability Engineering), AIOps, Cloud Native Architectures, ITSM/ITIL, or Cybersecurity Incident Response.
  • Exceptional public speaking and written communication skills.
  • Ability to travel across the US and occasionally overseas.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active involvement in the tech community (mentorship, open-source contribution, or advisory/board positions).
  • Experience navigating the regulatory landscape for US financial services or government sectors (e.g., FedRAMP) as it relates to cloud resiliency.

Hesitant to apply?

We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts!

Where we work

PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:

Location restrictions:
Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia
Canada: Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon
United States: Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming
Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.

How we work

Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

What we offer

As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our benefits site.

Your package may include:

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive benefits package 
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Company equity*
  • ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)*
  • Retirement or pension plan*
  • Generous paid vacation time
  • Paid holidays and sick leave
  • Dutonian Wellness Days & HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO
  • Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)*
  • Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year
  • Company-wide hack weeks
  • Mental wellness programs

*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure

About PagerDuty

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses

PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2. 

Go behind-the-scenes on our careers site and @pagerduty on Instagram.

Your privacy is important to us. By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read and understand PagerDuty's Privacy Policy.

PagerDuty is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. Should you require accommodation, please email accommodation@pagerduty.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

jobs.title: Wrike: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Czech Republic - Remote

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
 
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 
 

About the Role:

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. As the leading collaborative work management platform, Wrike generates an enormous amount of rich, interconnected data, including work item content, relationships between entities, complex business processes, user interactions, and direct user input. The mission of the DS/ML department is to transform this data into intelligent, AI-powered capabilities that help users gain deeper insights, automate routine work, enhance productivity, and create a more seamless work experience.

As a Data Scientist in the Work Intelligence Unit, you will play a key role in product development through the application of state-of-the-art AI and machine learning technologies with a particular focus on leveraging Large Language Models and other emerging technologies. You will work on both user-facing AI features and foundational intelligence platform that power intelligent experiences across the product. 

Your Impact:

  • Creating new and improving existing AI solutions Involvement in the whole process of data-driven development from analyzing product requirements to launching the feature or system to production (with the help of MLOps specialists) and improving it based on results of monitoring and feedback
  • Communicating with fellow data scientists, product owners, and developers
  • Applying best software engineering practices to build a reliable codebase
  • Performing code reviews
  • Working in agile environment and presenting the results of your work on regular sprint reviews

Your Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in AI,  Data Science, and Machine learning 
  • Experience in LLMs, LLM-based APIs, prompting techniques, metric-driven development of prompt-based features, agentic systems, and other related topics
  • Experience in building complex multipart and multistep LLM-based and ML systems
  • Proficiency in Python (including pure Python, and not only jupyter notebooks)
  • Experience in using reproducible research techniques
  • Experience in developing AI solutions for production usage
  • Full professional proficiency in English

Standout Qualities:

  • Experience in AI and ML solutions related to one of the areas: social networks, recommendation systems, ranking, entity matching, process mining, system personalization, risk estimation
  • Confident statistical and machine learning skills 
  • Experience in creating core AI systems that are foundational to the product and are used in many parts of it
  • Experience in classical software development and architecture

Interpersonal skills:

  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills required with the ability to work within all levels of an organization.
  • You are proactively pushing yourself to develop your skills and knowledge
  • Decision making and argumentation skills
  • Open to feedback and ready to react on it
  • Ability to work autonomously on a project level

Our Work Style:

  • Code: Python, Jupyter, mypy, uv, black, flake8
  • Data: pandas, SQL, BigQuery
  • GenAI & LLMs: Langchain, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Vertex AI, Braintrust
  • LLM Platform: Versioned Prompt Registry(jinja2), Declarative LLM Feature Configs (multi-step workflows, model routing)
  • ML: scikit-learn, lightgbm, pytorch
  • Cloud: GCP, Dagster, MLFlow
  • Coding Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor

Team Dynamics:

As part of Wrike’s AI center of excellence — you will help scale AI feature development across teams by collaborating closely with product, engineering, design, research, and other departments across the organization. You will explore new AI-driven opportunities, validate hypotheses through experimentation, and drive innovations from research prototypes to production-ready capabilities that deliver tangible value to millions of users.

Benefits & Perks:

  • 5 Weeks of paid vacation
  • Sick Leave Compensation 
    • 5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days
    • 2 weeks fully paid w/ medical certificate, additional 
    • 4 weeks paid at 80% salary rate
  • Parental Leave (fully paid): 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity 
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Meal Vouchers (CZK 220 per working day)
  • Annual Prague Travel Card (Lítačka)
  • Hybrid Working Model
  • Benefit budget with flexible options, including a MultiSport card, Canadian Medical membership, contributions to a pension savings plan and additional choices available through Benefit Plus

What’s Next?

  • Introduction Call with a Recruiter
  • Technical interview
  • Cultural interview

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

#LI-AV1

 

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
 
Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
 
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona 

  Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
  Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
  Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. 

Our culture and Values 

Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. 

Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

 
Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

jobs.title: Webflow: Senior Developer Educator
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid); U.S. Remote

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We’re looking for a Senior Developer Educator to help us create best-in-class video, written, and hands-on education content for Webflow customers, and those who want to define the next phases of the web. You’ll present on camera as a developer educator, and,  to keep your skills fresh, you’ll build production grade sites using Webflow that we use in our education videos and courses. You’ll also keep your skills fresh by learning how to integrate Webflow with other services and technologies and then develop content demonstrating how.

About the role:

  • Location: San Francisco HQ or Remote (United States)
    • Travel required to SF - 1 week per month
  • Full-time
  • Permanent
  • Exempt
  • The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills.

    • United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)
      • Zone A: $129,000 - $155,000
      • Zone B: $121,500 - $146,000
      • Zone C: $113,000 - $136,000

This role is also eligible to participate in Webflow's company-wide bonus program. Target amounts are a percentage of base salary and vary by career level. Payouts are based on company performance against established financial and operational goals. 

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

  • Application Information:
    • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
    • This posting is for a new position

  • Reporting to the Director, Education Video

 As a Senior Developer Educator you’ll … 

  • Build the reference websites that anchor Webflow University courses, tutorials, and live training — real, production-quality sites and components that hold up to scrutiny from developers and designers, not just demos that survive a screen recording (see examples in our videos at Webflow University)
  • Shape technical curriculum in partnership with instructional designers and video producers, scoping what each lesson needs to demonstrate and why, before anything gets built or shot
  • Present technical content on camera for tutorials, course lessons, and live sessions — walking through code and craft with the clarity of someone who actually built the thing
  • Work alongside video producers and instructional designers through pre-production, shooting, and review, so what's on screen empowers learners to do the thing
  • Serve as the education team's technical subject matter expert, reviewing content for accuracy and pressure-testing it against how people really work and build
  • Keep the technical library current as the platform ships, deciding what's gone stale, what needs rebuilding, and what's newly worth teaching
  • Partner with product and engineering to understand what's coming, so education is ready when it launches rather than catching up after

About you:

Requirements:

  • 4+  years of experience in technical education and web development and/or design
  • Proficient in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with the ability to write, review, and explain code - leveraging AI tools to accelerate development and refine quality.
  • Demonstrated experience teaching technical concepts to a mixed audience through video, documentation, courses, workshops, or community work
  • Willingness and ability to present on camera - from an outline or word-for-word script, in studio or from your own home setup

You’ll thrive as a Senior Technical Educator if you:

  • Build things because you need to understand them, not just to ship them
  • Can address multiple audiences — the visual developer who's never opened a code editor, the engineer evaluating how Webflow can help them build better, and the marketer who’s been handed off components and templates to build with
  • Take feedback on your on-camera work as craft input rather than personal critique
  • Enjoy collaborating with technical and less technical education teammates alike, recognizing the unique role each person plays in the success of a project
  • Are passionate about learning, education, and helping others succeed
  • Are equally confident showing the messy middle of a build or the polished result
  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible
  • Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.
  • Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally. 
  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Be you, with us

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor. 

Please note:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Twikey: Senior Java Developer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium
URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs

Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.

Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough.

Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.

Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.

As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.

  • You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.
  • With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.
  • You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.

What are we looking for in you?

  • You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.
  • Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn. You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.
  • You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning. You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.
  • You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.
  • You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.
  • You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework. Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.

jobs.title: Twilio: Billing Operations Analyst 1
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - Mexico

Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Billing Operations Analyst.

 

Twilio is looking for a talented and results driven person who is passionate about work, savvy about billing and pricing from the business view not only financial and who lives the Twilio Magic They also have:

Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal, and ability to advocate for a position while maintaining a collaborative, and open-minded approach. You should be someone who is a champion of streamlining processes and sees projects through to completion. We are looking for someone who enjoys and thrives in a fast-paced environment, with zealous attention to detail, good judgment, and is dedicated to providing excellent customer service.  

Responsibilities

In this role you’ll:

  • Maintain Revenue Team external customer email, responding to customer and other external queries in a timely manner and onboard customers to Twilio’s internal billing system and Financial ERP system, Gather and format large raw data sets to assist with customer billing reporting and queries.
  • Participate in month end close, including: Managing and tracking recurring billing and managing approvals, tracking and application of customer credits. Analysis of revenue related balance sheet accounts, Ad hoc customer financial reporting.
  • Assist and participate in the development and implementation of financial controls and process surrounding revenue and invoicing, Onboard customers to Twilio’s internal billing system and Financial ERP system.
  • Participate in external and internal audits, as requested.
  • Resolve queries customers are facing relating to their billing. 
  • Independently investigate customer issues, searching internal resources, previous cases, Slack channels etc to understand issues and provide detailed analysis of customer issues to the Sales team.
  • Manipulate and analyze large datasets in Excel. 
  • Respond to the Sales team in a timely manner and communicate complicated issues via Slack, via SFDC, via calls. Excellent communication skills are required - occasional calls with customers or Senior Leaders may be required. 
  • Work under pressure - high paced environment, quick turnaround times in order to comply with team SLA’s
  • Collaborate with other teams in order to solve root problems to customer issues
  • Help out on other teams within the Billing Ops group, as requested
  • Participate in Month End close, as requested.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

 

Required:

  • Strong experience in the area of Billings / Revenue / Order to Cash.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving, strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Experience working with Oracle, Zuora and Salesforce is advantageous, although not essential.
  • Solid experience working with large volume transactions with strong attention to detail.
  • Advanced Excel user: able to handle very large raw data sets using pivots and other functions such as VLOOKUPS.
  • 1-3 years experience in an Operations role.
  • Periodic weekend work will also be essential for this role.
  • Third level qualification in Accountancy, Finance or a Business related discipline or equivalent experience.
  • Proficient Spanish and English.

 

Location

This role will be remote, and based in  Mexico City Mexico.




Travel 

 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.title: AssemblyAI: Senior Research Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build,  this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply!

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Research Engineer to join our Research team, developing and improving the systems behind large-scale distributed training, data processing, and inference. Our goal as an organization is to solve customer problems and improve our products quickly through model development and measurement — and how fast we move depends on how quickly anyone here can run an experiment, measure it, and find out what's wrong. Raising that ceiling is the heart of this role. You'll be working inside the pipeline you're improving, not alongside it.

The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of modern deep learning systems, combined with strong engineering expertise across JAX and TPUs, layer-level optimization, large-scale distributed training, streaming, low-latency and asynchronous inference, inference compilers, and advanced parallelization techniques.

This is a cross-functional role. You'll work closely with our researchers, our infrastructure team, and production engineering — not as a handoff point, but as the person who learns enough of each domain to follow problems through to resolution. At times you'll train models, run evaluations, and analyze data yourself, both to deliver impact directly and to learn what's worth building to multiply the team's work. The bar is someone who understands the end-to-end impact they intend to make, measures it from the outset, and would rather find out they were wrong in a week than in a quarter. That discipline is what turns cross-functional ownership into an advantage.

The role is embedded within the Research team. 

What You’ll Do

  • Raise the team's experimental velocity — make it faster to launch an experiment job, get a number back you can trust, and know what to try next.
  • Maintain and evolve our JAX training framework, keeping it scalable and efficient for large-scale distributed training runs on TPU.
  • Improve the data our models learn from: investigating quality issues, building the tooling to surface them, and turning what you find into measurable accuracy gains.
  • Analyze the accuracy of production models, build evaluation harnesses, and work out which improvements will matter most to customers.
  • Translate research prototypes into production-ready systems, refactoring and modernizing model architectures and infrastructure along the way.
  • Optimize production inference for speech language models, both from a serving architecture perspective and through advanced techniques such as quantization and speculative decoding.
  • Investigate and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack, from low-level kernels (XLA, Pallas) to high-level system design.
  • Partner with researchers, infrastructure, and production engineering to trace problems to their real source and ship fixes that hold.

What You’ll Need

  • Expert-level proficiency with JAX and TPUs, including the surrounding ecosystem (Flax, Optax, the XLA compilation pipeline).
  • Measurement discipline. You define what success looks like before you start, you stay skeptical of your own results until they hold up, and you treat an unexplained improvement as a problem rather than a win.
  • Appetite for the whole pipeline. Your core strength might be JAX and TPU performance, but when a customer issue traces back to a data problem or an evaluation blind spot, you want to go find it yourself. The people who do well here went deep in one area first, then kept expanding outward.
  • Strong experience optimizing inference systems for production, ideally with LLMs or speech models.
  • Deep understanding of distributed training at scale, modern deep learning systems, and ML infrastructure best practices.
  • Familiarity with modern inference optimization techniques: continuous batching, KV-cache management, sharding strategies, quantization.
  • Enthusiasm for refactoring and improving existing systems — you thrive on making products and code faster and better.
  • Strong Python skills; C++ or Rust experience for kernel-level work is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and a collaborative mindset — you can clearly explain complex tradeoffs and prioritize high-impact work.

Bonus

  • Domain knowledge in Speech-to-Text: ASR architectures, audio processing, streaming inference. 

Pay Transparency:

AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size, stage, and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefit, and other reward opportunities we provide.

In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

The provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range which will be communicated to candidates throughout the interview process.

We're hiring our first Senior GTM AI Engineer. This is a software engineering job inside the revenue org. You will build the pipelines, internal tools, and agents that decide which companies we go after, how we reach them, and what our sellers see when they open their laptop in the morning.

Most of what a sales ops team used to do by hand is now something you can write software to do. Finding every company building voice AI before they contact us. Researching an account and drafting the first email. Watching product usage and telling an AE when a customer is about to expand or churn. Keeping the CRM clean without anyone filling in forms. You will build those systems, run them in production, and be judged on whether pipeline and revenue move.

Your users are our AEs, SDRs, and GTM leaders. Your job is to make a small team perform like one three times its size.

What You'll Do

  • Write code every day. Python services, SQL models, scheduled jobs, and small internal apps are most of the job. You'll use Claude Code and similar tools to ship in days what used to take a quarter.
  • Build agents that do the work: account research, lead qualification, outreach drafting, CRM hygiene, and usage monitoring. Design them, give them tools and data, evaluate their output, and keep them running.
  • Turn product usage data in BigQuery and Looker into signals sellers act on: usage alerts, expansion triggers, and account health scores.
  • Build the account targeting machine: sourcing, enrichment, dedupe, and ICP scoring, from raw data to a ranked list in a rep's queue.
  • Integrate the systems the team already uses (our CRM, enrichment providers, outbound tools) so data moves between them without a human in the loop.
  • Keep funnel data trustworthy: routing rules, field governance, and attribution.
  • Prototype fast, measure what works, kill what doesn't, and work directly with Sales and Marketing leadership on what to build next.
  • Document what you build so it keeps running without you.

  • 4+ years as a software engineer, data engineer, or growth/GTM engineer, with time spent shipping systems that other people depend on.
  • Strong Python and SQL. You have owned production automations end to end: APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, retries, error handling, and monitoring.
  • Experience building with LLMs beyond a single prompt: multi-step agents, tool use, retrieval, and evaluation. You can tell whether an agent's output is good, and you know when a plain script is the better tool.
  • AI-assisted development is how you work. You use Claude Code or similar tools daily, and you have the engineering judgment to review, test, and stand behind what they produce.
  • Solid fundamentals: clean code, version control, code review, debugging, and a habit of thinking in systems. You do not need an engineering team to ship.
  • Curiosity about how a sales org works. You don't need a RevOps background, but you need to care about how deals get found and closed, and be willing to learn our CRM and the tools around it quickly.
  • A builder's mindset with an operator's judgment: you scope for business impact, ship iteratively, and measure results in pipeline and revenue.
  • Low ego, high ownership, and comfort being the single-threaded owner of an entire domain.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on Salesforce or other CRM work at the object and API level, or experience with enrichment and outbound tools like Clay.
  • dbt, BigQuery, and Looker, or an equivalent warehouse and BI stack.

jobs.title: Smartsheet: Group Product Manager – Corporate Systems
jobs.description:
Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Corporate Systems Engineering builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet’s core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People & Culture.  Our team owns mission-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software.

Corporate Systems Product Management focuses on the internal platforms that power how Smartsheet operates - including Finance, People, Sales and Entitlements, Billing and Monetization, Enterprise Systems Data, and AI & Automation. Product Managers in this team steward product strategy, roadmaps, business workflows, and long-term platform evolution across these domains, partnering closely with Engineering and business stakeholders to translate complex enterprise needs into scalable technology outcomes.

As Group Product Manager – Corporate Systems, you will lead the Product Management function across Corporate Systems, managing and developing a team of Product Managers responsible for some of Smartsheet’s most critical internal technology domains. You will establish a cohesive product strategy across the portfolio, ensuring domain roadmaps connect to company priorities while identifying dependencies and opportunities that span traditional organizational and system boundaries.

You will operate at both the strategic and execution levels: coaching Product Managers to develop strong product practices, partnering with Engineering leadership on portfolio strategy and investment decisions, and directly engaging in the most complex cross-functional initiatives. You will help evolve Corporate Systems from a collection of enterprise applications and projects into a product-led portfolio of platforms, capabilities, data, integrations, and employee experiences designed for long-term scale.

You will report to the Senior Director of Corporate Systems and collaborate closely with Engineering leadership and senior stakeholders across Finance, People & Culture, Sales/GTM, Product Engineering, Data, Security, and other business functions.

You Will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers responsible for Financial Systems, People Systems, Sales & Entitlements, Billing & Monetization, Enterprise Systems Data, and AI & Automation
  • Define and evolve the product-management operating model for Corporate Systems, establishing consistent practices for product discovery, customer problem definition, roadmap development, prioritization, requirements, metrics, and lifecycle management
  • Establish a cohesive portfolio strategy that connects individual product domains to Corporate Systems and company-level objectives
  • Partner with Engineering leadership to align product and technical strategy, ensuring investments balance new capabilities with platform health, reliability, scalability, security, technical debt, and operational sustainability
  • Drive portfolio-level prioritization and investment decisions across competing business needs, helping teams focus capacity on the highest-value problems and outcomes
  • Identify and manage dependencies across domains, particularly where business processes span Product, Sales, entitlements, billing, Finance, People systems, integrations, automation, and enterprise data
  • Coach Product Managers to deeply understand their customers, business processes, systems, data flows, and technical constraints rather than operating primarily as requirements or project managers
  • Raise the technical and systems fluency of the Product Management organization, enabling PMs to effectively partner with software engineers, architects, application engineers, Data teams, and Security
  • Ensure product strategies and roadmaps are grounded in measurable customer and business outcomes, with clear success metrics and mechanisms for evaluating product health and value
  • Create clarity across ambiguous or highly cross-functional initiatives where ownership, requirements, system boundaries, or desired outcomes are not immediately clear
  • Partner with senior business leaders to understand strategic priorities and translate them into coherent technology capabilities and investment plans
  • Lead product thinking for major cross-domain transformations such as new pricing and monetization models, enterprise AI adoption, ERP and billing modernization, enterprise data governance, and automation
  • Establish mechanisms for portfolio planning, roadmap reviews, product health reviews, dependency management, and executive communication across Corporate Systems
  • Ensure Product Managers balance stakeholder requests with longer-term product strategy, challenging solution-first requirements and identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, or eliminate processes
  • Champion data-informed product management, including clear product KPIs, adoption measures, operational metrics, customer feedback, and outcome measurement
  • Partner with Engineering leadership to improve how Product and Engineering teams work together from discovery and design through delivery, operational readiness, adoption, and continuous improvement

Financial Systems Engineering owns and evolves the technology ecosystem that powers Smartsheet’s financial operations and monetization capabilities. jobs.title: QuickMail: Technical Customer Support
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Zurich, Switzerland
URL: https://quickmail.com

The role

We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.

You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.

Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.

The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.

This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.

We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.

If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

 

What work looks like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable

 

Every day

  • ⁠Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.
  • ⁠Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.
  • ⁠Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

 

Delighting customers

  • Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast. and set them up for success.
  • ⁠Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.
  • ⁠Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

 

Making support smarter with AI

  • ⁠Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.
  • Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.
  • ⁠Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

 

Keeping the product solid

  • ⁠Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.
  • Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.
  • ⁠Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

 

Running the week

  • ⁠Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.
  • ⁠Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

 

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Requirements

Who you are

  • You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.
  • You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.
  • You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.
  • You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like loom.
  • Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.
  • You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.
  • You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.
  • You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.
  • Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.
  • Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

 

A plus if you have

  • Have experience with customer facing, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.
  • Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup, . We can teach this, but a head start helps.
  • Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.
  • Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.
  • An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

 

How we work together

You’ll work directly with me, the founder, and with our lead developer.

Working with me can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • My replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something I wrote lands badly or isn’t clear, ask me.
  • My direction can change. I may say one thing, then something different a few days later as I learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.
  • I prefer information to be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if I ask.
  • I can stay frustrated about a problem until it’s solved. That's something I'm aware of and working on. You’ll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.
  • We often think fast and interrupt each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn’t for you.

 

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn’t take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion we need your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

 

Benefits

  • Contract type (full-time or part-time)
  • Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).
  • Start date: negotiable

jobs.title: Tines: Manager, Renewals
jobs.description:
Headquarters: North America (Remote)

Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows. 

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design. 

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

This is a remote role that must be based in EST.

At Tines, our Customer Experience organization is recognized by customers for the quality of our work, responsiveness to their needs, and commitment to helping them realize meaningful value from our platform.

Within Customer Experience, the Renewals team plays a critical role in protecting and growing our customer relationships by creating a predictable, consistent, and customer-centered renewal experience. Renewal Managers partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, and Deal Desk to manage the commercial renewal process, navigate complex negotiations, identify risk early, and ensure customers can continue their partnership with Tines with clarity and confidence.

As Manager, Renewals, you will lead and develop a high-performing team of Renewal Managers responsible for executing renewals across our customer base. You will be accountable for renewal performance, forecasting accuracy, commercial execution, team development, and the processes that allow the function to scale.

You will also play a key role in strengthening the broader customer lifecycle at Tines, helping establish clear ownership and operating rhythms between Customer Success, Renewals, and Sales while ensuring that customer value, risk, and commercial strategy come together effectively at renewal.

What will you be doing?

  • Lead and develop a team of Renewal Managers, providing coaching, commercial guidance, and clear direction to drive strong customer and business outcomes.
  • Own renewal performance across the portfolio, with accountability for Gross Revenue Retention, renewal rate, churn and contraction outcomes, and on-time renewal execution.
  • Establish and maintain a consistent renewal forecast, providing leadership with clear visibility into renewal timing, risk, expected outcomes, and areas requiring intervention.
  • Guide Renewal Managers through complex customer negotiations involving pricing, contract terms, multi-year agreements, competitive pressure, procurement, and other commercial challenges.
  • Ensure renewal engagement begins early and that Renewal Managers have the customer context, risk signals, value realization, and relationship insights required to execute effectively.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure clear ownership between customer outcomes and commercial renewal execution, with CSMs focused on value, adoption, relationships, and risk mitigation while Renewals leads the commercial renewal process.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to identify and coordinate expansion opportunities associated with renewal cycles while maintaining clear ownership across teams.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to improve renewal forecasting, CRM workflows, dashboards, automation, reporting, and operational discipline.
  • Develop scalable renewal motions across customer segments, including high-touch, mid-touch, and digital or automated approaches where appropriate.
  • Establish clear renewal playbooks, timelines, escalation paths, handoffs, and operating cadences that create consistency for customers and internal teams.
  • Establish and manage metrics and KPIs that measure renewal effectiveness, including GRR, logo retention, forecast accuracy, renewal timing, cycle time, multi-year adoption, team productivity, and portfolio health.
  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain strong commercial talent as the Renewals function and company continue to scale.

What will you bring with you?

  • 7+ years of experience in SaaS, enterprise software, Customer Success, Account Management, Renewals, Sales, or a similar commercial customer-facing environment.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated track record of coaching and developing high-performing customer-facing or commercial teams.
  • Experience owning or managing a meaningful recurring revenue portfolio and delivering against retention or renewal targets.
  • A strong understanding of SaaS business metrics including ARR, Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, churn, contraction, renewal rate, and expansion.
  • Experience building and managing renewal forecasts with a high degree of operational rigor and predictability.
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience navigating pricing, negotiation, procurement, contracting, and customer objections.
  • The ability to coach teams through complex commercial situations while balancing customer relationships, revenue protection, and long-term business value.
  • Experience working closely with Customer Success and Sales teams to coordinate customer strategy and commercial outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to identify trends, diagnose performance, and determine where intervention is required.
  • A track record of improving workflows, standardization, automation, or systems to increase organizational efficiency and capacity.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and demonstrated ability to influence Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and executive stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to navigate both detailed commercial discussions and senior executive conversations.

What success looks like

In this role, you will build a Renewals organization that creates greater predictability for the business and a simpler, more consistent experience for customers.

Your team will engage customers earlier, identify and address risk before renewals become reactive, execute commercial conversations with confidence, and provide accurate visibility into renewal outcomes. Customer Success teams will be able to remain focused on driving value, adoption, strategic relationships, and risk mitigation while Renewal Managers bring dedicated commercial expertise to the renewal process.

At the same time, you will help Tines develop a renewal motion that can scale with the business combining strong talent, clear ownership, operational discipline, automation, and data to improve retention and strengthen long-term customer relationships.

Target Annual Compensation: $150-170K OTE (70/30 split)
