jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

  • Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
  • Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
  • Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
  • Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
  • Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
  • Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
  • Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
  • Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

  • Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
  • Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
  • Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
  • Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
  • Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

  • DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
  • Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
  • GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
  • Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
  • Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.
  • Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

  • Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.
  • Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.
  • Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.
  • Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.
  • A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

About Smartly

Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.

We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities.

About Smartly

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

Visit Smartly to learn more.

jobs.title: Finance Business Partner - Membership & Consumer Finance (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Für ein wachstumsorientiertes Dienstleistungsunternehmen mit kundenbasierten, wiederkehrenden Geschäftsmodellen suchen wir einen Finance Business Partner (m/w/d). In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die kaufmännische Steuerung zentraler Geschäftsbereiche und sind geschätzter Sparringspartner für Management und Fachbereiche.

Aufgaben

  • Kaufmännische Begleitung der verantworteten Geschäftsbereiche sowie Beratung des Managements in steuerungsrelevanten Fragestellungen (Business Partnering)

  • Verantwortung für Budget, Forecast und Mehrjahresplanung inklusive P&L-, Bilanz- und Cash-Planung sowie Analyse und Kommentierung wesentlicher Abweichungen

  • Weiterentwicklung der finanziellen und operativen Steuerung mit Fokus auf Wachstum, Umsatz, Marge, Profitabilität und Cash-Bedarf

  • Analyse zentraler Werttreiber wie Neukundengewinnung, Pricing, Akquisitionskosten, Kundenbindung sowie Produkt- und Partnerkosten

  • Steuerung von Finanzierungsvolumen, Forderungen, Unit Economics sowie Ergebnis-, Funding- und Cash-Entwicklung

  • Erstellung von Business Cases, Szenario- und Sensitivitätsanalysen für neue Produkte, Kooperationen und Wachstumsinitiativen

  • Erstellung adressatengerechter Management- und Board-Reportings sowie Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen

Qualifikation

  • Sie haben ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Controlling, Finance oder Rechnungswesen abgeschlossen.

  • Sie verfügen über mindestens fünf Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Controlling.

  • Sie sind mit Controlling in Unternehmensgruppen vertraut.

  • Sie arbeiten sehr sicher mit gängigen ERP-Systemen und Excel und setzen PowerPoint für Entscheidungsunterlagen ein.

  • Sie kommunizieren sicher mit dem Management und verfügen über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

Arbeitsort ist Frankfurt am Main. Bei der angebotenen Position handelt es sich um eine Vollzeitstelle in Festanstellung.

  • Sie erhalten Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung und beruflichen Entwicklung.

  • Sie profitieren von flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen und der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten.

  • Sie können eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und einen Zuschuss zur Ausstattung für mobiles Arbeiten nutzen.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Bei Fragen steht Ihnen Herr Marcus Heinrich, unter der Rufnummer 0179 / 12 92 419 gerne zur Verfügung.

jobs.title: C005435 Principal Technician (ICT Systems) (NS) - MON 26 Oct
jobs.description:
Deadline Date: Monday 26 October 2026

Requirement: Principal Technician (ICT Systems)

Location: The Hague, NL

Full Time On-Site: Yes

Time On-Site: 100%

Total Scope of the request (hours): 300

Required Start Date: 3 November 2026

End Contract Date: 31 December 2026

Required Security Clearance: NATO SECRET

 

Duties & Role: 

The Principal Technician (ICT Systems) is responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of information and communication technology systems. He/she provide technical support to end-users and troubleshoot any issues that arise. They stay up to date with the latest technology trends and make recommendations for system improvements. They handle tasks related to configuring hardware and software, managing computers and networks devices, troubleshooting technical issues, ensuring data security and system reliability, and provide technical support to end-users. They collaborate with various departments to understand their technology needs and optimize the organization's ICT infrastructure to support business operations efficiently.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Software configuration

  • Assists in designing, verifying, documenting, amending and refactoring moderately complex software configurations for deployment.
  • Applies agreed standards and tools, to achieve a well-engineered result.
  • Collaborates in reviews of work with others as appropriate.

System software

  • Monitors operational systems for resource usage and failure rates, to inform and facilitate system software tuning.
  • Applies system software parameters to maximise throughput and efficiency.
  • Installs and tests new versions of system software.
  • Contributes to preparation of software implementation procedures with fall back contingency plans.

Network support

  • Carries out agreed network maintenance tasks and specified operational configuration of network components.
  • Establish and diagnose network problems/faults using the required troubleshooting methodology and tools.
  • Uses network management software and tools to collect agreed performance and traffic statistics.

Systems installation and removal

  • Installs or removes hardware and/or software, using supplied installation instructions and tools, including handover to the client.
  • Uses standard procedures and diagnostic tools to test installations, correct problems, and document results.
  • Records details of all components that have been installed and removed.
  • Assists users and follows agreed procedures for further help or escalation.
  • Contributes to the development of installation procedures and standards.

Release and deployment

  • Uses approved tools and techniques for specific deployment activities.
  • Administers the recording of activities, logging of results and documents technical activities undertaken.

Additional duties for this post:

The Principal Technician (ICT Systems) will provide 24/7 Immediate On-Call Response to the Service Operations with technical AirC2 expertise and solutions at Level 2 support with ticket response and resolutions that will meet current operational needs and defined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

The Principal Technician (ICT Systems) will work as an on-site integrated member of the assigned service team, when not on 24/7 on-call duty for immediate ticket response and resolution. He will help with the design, development, test and on-site support of engineering changes to services, processes, organisation, operating model and other aspects. This effort may be required in addition to his/her daily service operations and maintenance tasks.

Requirements

Skills, Knowledge & Experience:

  • The candidate must have a currently active NATO SECRET security clearance
  • Higher vocational training in a relevant discipline with 3 years post-related experience. Or a secondary educational qualification with 5 years post-related experience.
  • At least 3 years practical experience of implementation and maintenance of ICT end systems within a large organization.
  • Good experience configuring hardware and software.
  • Good understanding of ICT systems and the ability to work independently to solve problems.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting technical issues and providing technical support to end-users.

Desirable:

  • Hands-on experience on troubleshooting technical issues and providing technical support to end-users.
  • Network configuration, debugging trouble shouting (TCP/IP, VPN, VLAN, firewall, DNS).
  • Cybersecurity infrastructure understanding.
  • Software development in java, C, C++, python, scripting language.
  • Hardware and software configuration of Server hosting platforms, custom disk configurations with specific storage controllers, RAID configuration, redundancy management.
  • Overall Strong analytical and problem-solving skills on: Remote server administration; Log analysis; Network tool usage (Wireshark)
  • ITIL foundation or advanced level training and certification.

What You'll Do

  • Embed with customer teams to learn how certification, inspection, and compliance work in practice.

  • Lead customer conversations, write product specifications, and build end-to-end systems across the frontend, backend, data model, and AI layer.

  • Own product areas from discovery through deployment, shipping early and refining solutions based on direct user feedback.

  • Review customer documents and workflow outputs to develop AI-enabled tools for scheduling, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence.

  • Use sound product judgment to distinguish broadly useful needs from one-off requests.

What We're Looking For

  • Three to six years of software or product engineering experience, with a track record of shipping production software.

  • Full-stack capability, including Python, TypeScript, React, Node.js, SQL, data modeling, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with AI/ML, large language models, or document intelligence is valuable.

  • Strong product-building instincts and experience contributing in an early-stage or ground-up product environment.

  • Comfort working directly with customers, communicating clearly, and adapting to real-world operational needs.

  • Strong technical fundamentals and a personable, practical approach to collaboration.

Compensation & Benefits

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. 

Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. jobs.description:
Do you get energy from winning new customers? Do you know how to build a pipeline from scratch, engage senior decision-makers and turn complex business challenges into successful deals?

At Yenlo, we are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive who knows how to create opportunities, not just manage them.

This is a true hunting role, with the opportunity to make a direct impact on Yenlo's growth. We have built a strong international business in Integration, API Management, Identity & Access Management and Managed Services. Now we are expanding into Data, AI, Automation and Control. We have the technology expertise, strong partnerships and delivery capabilities. What we need is someone who can bring us to the right table, create demand and win new business.

About Yenlo

Yenlo has helped organisations connect their business-critical systems and processes for more than 17 years. We do this with around 100 colleagues from over 18 nationalities, with offices in the Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Sri Lanka, the United States and Canada. We have been a WSO2 Platinum Partner since 2008 and a Boomi partner since 2015, and our customers include Boeing, Hard Rock Café and several ministries and universities. Now we are building on our integration expertise with Data, AI and Automation, so customers can bring their technology into production securely and reliably. For that, we are looking for someone who opens new markets.

What will you do?

As Enterprise Account Executive, your primary mission is to win new customers and build profitable, long-term business relationships.

You will focus on mid-market and enterprise organisations across the Benelux and DACH regions, particularly those facing complex challenges around applications, integration, data, cloud transformation and AI.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Win new logos and build your own pipeline. Identify target accounts, open doors and generate business through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and strategic partnerships.

  • Engage senior decision-makers and sell business value. Build relationships with CIOs, CTOs and other business and technology leaders, and translate their challenges into opportunities around Integration, Data, AI, Automation and Control.

  • Own the sales cycle. Lead opportunities from initial engagement through proposal, negotiation and closing, together with our solution architects, consultants and product specialists.

  • Help shape our go-to-market. Bring customer insights and market feedback into Yenlo to help us improve our propositions and commercial approach.

  • Deliver results. Take ownership of your pipeline, forecasts, new-business targets and the profitability of the deals you win.

You will have access to existing customer references, partner relationships and marketing support. But this is not a role where you inherit a ready-to-close pipeline or rely on an SDR team to fill your calendar. We expect you to create opportunities yourself and have the commercial drive to turn them into business.

What can you expect from Yenlo?

At Yenlo, you will join an international technology company with around 100 colleagues, strong technical expertise and ambitious plans for the future.

We offer:

  • Real ownership. A new-business role with the freedom to develop opportunities and make a visible commercial impact.

  • Attractive earning potential. A competitive fixed salary and a substantial performance-based bonus, with uncapped upside for overachievement.

  • A strong technology portfolio. Established capabilities in Integration, API Management, IAM and Managed Services, complemented by growing propositions in Data, AI and Control.

  • Access to specialists. Experienced solution architects, consultants and product teams to support discovery, demonstrations, assessments and proposals.

  • An international ecosystem. Partnerships with leading technology providers, including Boomi and WSO2, alongside Yenlo's own Connext platform.

  • Room to build. The opportunity to contribute to our evolving commercial approach, propositions and go-to-market strategy.

  • Professional benefits. Pension arrangements, holiday allowance, a lease car or mobility allowance, laptop and phone.

  • A realistic start. An appropriate ramp-up period, recognising that enterprise sales cycles take time and building a pipeline starts from day one.

You will work closely with our sales leadership and wider commercial organisation. We believe in face-to-face collaboration, both with customers and colleagues, and expect you to spend time at our Schiphol-Rijk office on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays.


We are looking for a commercially driven, entrepreneurial sales professional with a proven track record in complex B2B technology sales.

You know how to build relationships, navigate enterprise organisations and close significant deals.

What you bring:

  • A demonstrable track record of generating your own pipeline and personally closing new enterprise customers.

  • Experience selling complex IT services, software, cloud, integration or other enterprise technology solutions.

  • Experience managing six-figure deals and longer, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Strong outbound prospecting, consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills.

  • The ability to engage credibly with senior business and technology decision-makers.

  • Enough technical understanding to discuss Integration, APIs, Data and AI, while focusing on business outcomes rather than technical features.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and the resilience to succeed without a fully established sales playbook.

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with technical and commercial colleagues.

  • Professional proficiency in Dutch and English.

Experience with platforms such as Boomi, WSO2, MuleSoft, AWS, Azure or related enterprise technologies is an advantage, but not a requirement. An existing network in the Benelux or DACH enterprise market would be a strong plus. We care more about what you have personally achieved than the number of years on your CV or the technology companies you have worked for.

Ready to make an impact?

If you enjoy opening doors, creating opportunities and winning complex enterprise deals, we would love to meet you.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Claims & Legal
jobs.description:
Over ons
 
Steeds meer mensen in Europa kiezen ervoor om zelfstandig te werken als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Zelfstandig werken biedt vrijheid en flexibiliteit om te bepalen wanneer, hoe en met wie je wilt werken. Het zien groeien van je eigen bedrijf kan zowel professioneel als financieel belonend zijn.
 
Zelfstandig zijn brengt echter ook onzekerheden met zich mee. De juiste verzekeringen zijn essentieel om voorbereid te zijn op de risico’s van het ondernemerschap.
 
Bij Insify bieden we transparante, flexibele en eerlijk geprijsde verzekeringen, afgestemd op de behoeften van ondernemers. Zo kunnen zij zich volledig richten op hun werk, in de wetenschap dat ze altijd op ons kunnen rekenen.
Insify verzekert duizenden klanten in heel Europa. Wij bieden betrouwbare verzekeringen zonder ingewikkeld papierwerk. Een verzekering bij Insify sluit je 100% digitaal af, vandaag geregeld is morgen verzekerd.
 
Hoe wij werken
 
Bij Insify hebben we vier kernwaarden: doorzettingsvermogen, impact, zorg en ondernemerschap. Die leggen we kort even uit:
Doorzettingsvermogen: We zijn niet bang voor uitdagingen en gaan juist door waar anderen stoppen.
Impact: We maken het verschil in het leven van onze klanten en belonen hun vertrouwen in ons. 
Zorg: Wij stellen onze klanten altijd centraal. Hun succes is ons doel.
Ondernemerschap: Innovatie zit in ons DNA. We gaan snel en we denken groot.  
 
Bij Insify word je onderdeel van een hecht team. Daarom werken we het liefst zo veel mogelijk op kantoor. Dat klinkt misschien raar voor een 100% online verzekeraar, maar wij geloven dat een sterke onderlinge band ons helpt sneller te innoveren en onze klanten nog beter te bedienen. Zo’n band is eigenlijk alleen via persoonlijk contact te realiseren.
Door regelmatig naar kantoor te komen, leren nieuwe collega’s bovendien sneller en voelen ze zich eerder thuis.
 
We begrijpen ook dat je misschien niet elke dag naar kantoor kunt komen of dat er momenten zijn dat je je focus nodig hebt. Daarom is gedeeltelijk thuiswerken in overleg mogelijk.
 
Operations Team
 
Wij zijn degenen die vertrouwen opbouwen bij elk contactmoment—of het nu om een verkoop, een supportgesprek of het afhandelen van een claim gaat. We zorgen ervoor dat prospects en klanten zich gesteund, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Snelheid en kwaliteit zijn voor ons belangrijk, en we volgen onze voortgang nauwgezet zodat we blijven verbeteren. Met het oog op de toekomst bereiden we ons voor op medische acceptatie in 2025—een volgende stap om onze service nóg sterker te maken.

Jouw rol
 
Binnen Insify zijn we op zoek naar een ambitieuze werkstudent rechten die op zoek is naar een betekenisvolle bijbaan naast de studie. Een rol waarin juridische kennis direct wordt toegepast, klantcontact centraal staat en waardevolle ervaring wordt opgedaan die uitstekend aansluit bij een toekomstige juridische carrière.
 
Als werkstudent Claims & Legal Support ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten van Insify met een schade- of arbeidsongeschiktheidsclaim. Je combineert klantgerichtheid met juridische scherpte en zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten snel, eerlijk en zorgvuldig worden geholpen.
 
Je werkt nauw samen met onze Legal & Claims specialisten en denkt mee over complexe aansprakelijkheidskwesties en bezwaarprocedures. Jij zorgt dat onze belofte van snelle, heldere en menselijke service ook in de praktijk wordt waargemaakt.

Jouw profiel
  • Aanspreekpunt voor klanten. Je helpt klanten die schade melden of arbeidsongeschikt zijn geraakt. Je luistert, stelt de juiste vragen en begeleidt hen door het proces.
  • Claims behandelen. Je beoordeelt claims inhoudelijk en zorgt voor een efficiënte en correcte afhandeling, met oog voor zowel klant als organisatie.
  • Meedenken in complexe dossiers. Je ondersteunt bij lastige casussen, bijvoorbeeld rond aansprakelijkheid of bij het opstellen van reacties op bezwaren.
  • Samenwerken met Legal. Je schakelt met het juridische team bij ingewikkelde vraagstukken en werkt mee aan het verder verbeteren van interne processen
  • Een tweede of derdejaars bachelorstudent of een masterstudent Verzekeringsrecht of Nederlands Recht heeft onze voorkeur. 
  • Goede beheersing van zowel de Engels als Nederlandse taal. 
  • Beschikbaar voor minimaal 2 of 3 dagen per week voor minimaal 6 maanden; 
    • Wat wij bieden
     
    Concurrerende vergoeding - We willen de besten aantrekken en behouden, daarom bieden we een compensatiepakket dat daarbij past.
    Pensioenregeling - Deelname aan Insify’s pensioenplan, met 6% werkgeversbijdrage.
    Reiskostenvergoeding - We helpen reizigers met hun woon-werkverkeer.
    Hybride werken - Mogelijkheid om twee keer per week vanuit huis te werken. Als ervaren professional kun je remote werken en kom je af en toe naar kantoor.
    25 vakantiedagen per jaar - (+ een extra dag op kerstavond als het een werkdag is!)
    Abonnement op Alleo - 50 EUR (netto) maandelijks (op te sparen) budget om uit te geven aan wat je wilt - van sportschoolabonnementen tot UberEats!
    Leuke events - Maandelijkse team drinks, kwartaal uitjes, lunch & learns, feesten, merch en FUN!
    Bedrijfs MacBook - Krijg de beste laptop om je werk snel en efficiënt te doen!
    Snelle carrièreontwikkeling - Er is geen betere plek om je carrière te ontwikkelen. Wij groeien en jij kunt met ons meegroeien! Interne leiderschapsprogramma’s en coaching.
    Hoge mate van autonomie - Het is tijd om ECHT impact te maken!

Deployment Strategist - Crypto Investigations
jobs.description:
Global Services helps Chainalysis customers turn blockchain data and investigative tools into practical results. Our customers include law enforcement, national security teams, financial institutions, and organisations across the crypto industry.

We’re looking for a Deployment Strategist, Crypto Investigations, to join Global Services and support public-sector customers in France, particularly law enforcement and intelligence teams. You’ll use your investigative experience and technical skills to help customers get the most out of Chainalysis products. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role focused on investigations and practical problem-solving rather than software engineering.

You’ll work with customers throughout their engagement with Chainalysis, from understanding their needs and conducting investigations to developing workflows, delivering training, and helping them build their own capabilities. You’ll need sound investigative judgement, strong French communication skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships with customers.


In this role, you’ll:

  • Support customer engagements from initial discovery and pre-sales through investigations, solution delivery, training, and ongoing support

  • Conduct blockchain investigations using Chainalysis products, particularly Reactor

  • Work with law enforcement, intelligence, and other public-sector customers to understand their objectives and help them achieve practical results

  • Build and adapt investigative workflows, queries, reports, and dashboards using Chainalysis tools and data

  • Help customers put investigative workflows into practice and develop the skills to use Chainalysis independently

  • Build trusted customer relationships by providing practical investigative guidance and product expertise

  • Lead customer meetings, demonstrations, investigative walkthroughs, training sessions, and technical briefings

  • Support pre-sales discussions by understanding customer requirements and explaining how Chainalysis can help

  • Share customer feedback and investigative insights with Product, Engineering, Global Intel, and Sales

  • Share investigative techniques and best practices with colleagues across Global Services

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Experience conducting or supporting investigations in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, or a related field. Candidates with relevant crypto or financial-crime investigation experience from other backgrounds will also be considered

  • Experience working with public-sector, law-enforcement, intelligence, or other mission-focused stakeholders

  • Strong investigative judgement and the ability to explain findings clearly and build credibility with customers

  • The technical aptitude to learn investigative platforms and work with data; extensive software-engineering experience is not required

  • The ability to analyse complex information and communicate findings to both investigators and senior stakeholders

  • The flexibility to work across pre-sales, customer delivery, and ongoing support

  • Fluency in French, with the ability to work confidently with French-speaking customers

  • The ability to be based in France, ideally in Paris

Required Skills

Technical Skills

  • Confidence using investigative tools and the ability to develop expertise in Chainalysis Reactor

  • Ability to work with investigative data and turn customer requirements into practical workflows, queries, and reports

  • Familiarity with blockchain investigation tools or analytical workflows is an advantage; Python and SQL are not required

  • Ability to learn Chainalysis products and understand how their data can support customer investigations

Domain Expertise

  • Experience in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, financial crime, or another relevant investigative field

  • Understanding of investigative objectives, operational workflows, and the outcomes customers need to achieve

  • Ability to use investigative judgement to guide an investigation and advise customers on their approach

Customer & Communication Skills

  • Ability to build trusted customer relationships through investigative knowledge and practical support

  • Excellent spoken and written French, including the ability to explain complex investigative concepts clearly

  • Confidence leading customer meetings, briefings, demonstrations, and training sessions

  • Ability to help customers develop their own skills and use Chainalysis tools independently

Day to Day Activities

  • Conduct investigations using Chainalysis tools, primarily Reactor, based on customer requirements

  • Prepare investigative reports, workflows, queries, and other analytical outputs

  • Work directly with customers to develop and implement investigative workflows

  • Deliver hands-on training, walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions

  • Lead demonstrations, investigative briefings, and solution presentations

  • Support pre-sales discussions, technical discovery, and solution scoping

  • Gather customer feedback and share practical recommendations with Product, Engineering, and Global Intel

  • Manage multiple customer engagements while maintaining quality and responsiveness

  • Continue developing knowledge of blockchain investigations and emerging crypto-related threats

Personal Attributes

  • Curious about blockchain technology, crypto crime, and investigative techniques

  • Able to communicate clearly and adapt to different audiences

  • Comfortable taking ownership and making sound decisions in situations where the path forward may not be clear

  • Collaborative and willing to work across teams

  • Keen to develop specialist knowledge and share it with others

Nice to have experience: [icing on the cake, not a deal breaker]

  • Previous experience using Chainalysis products

  • Experience with cryptocurrency investigations, blockchain analytics, or financial-crime analysis

  • Experience in traditional finance or financial investigations

  • Experience providing expert evidence or supporting legal proceedings

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as BSA/AML, sanctions screening, MiCA, or the Travel Rule

  • Experience with data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or cloud-based analytics tools

  • Published research, intelligence reports, or other work relating to blockchain analytics or financial crime

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
jobs.description:
TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
IN SHORT

Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory.
  • Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites.
  • Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations.
  • Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet.
  • Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team.
  • Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software.
  • Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first.
  • Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans.
  • Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup.


YOUR PROFILE

  • Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework.
  • Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait.
  • Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin.
  • Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code.
  • Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers.
  • High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end.
  • Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus.
  • Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.
  • Valid work permit or Swiss passport.


OUR BENEFITS

  • Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true
  • Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine
  • 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation 
  • Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day
  • We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund
  • New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.
  • We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard
  • Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing
  • Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions
 
Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.


ABOUT US

FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. 
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

SumUp accélère le déploiement de ses équipes de vente terrain en France, et ce poste à responsabilité façonnera cette croissance à Toulouse, en apportant nos outils de paiement et de gestion aux petites entreprises de la région. C'est l'occasion de construire une région depuis ses fondations, avec une évolution possible vers un poste de Territory Manager à mesure que l'équipe et l'activité se développent, en rapportant au Head of Region France.

Vos missions

  • Diriger et développer une équipe de consultants commerciaux terrain indépendants, en construisant les compétences et la culture nécessaires pour s'imposer sur le marché

  • Porter les objectifs d'acquisition de revenus de la région, piloter le portefeuille de marchands acquis et le développer par la vente croisée et la montée en gamme

  • Fixer le niveau d'exigence en matière de performance commerciale, en ancrant une culture de coaching et de responsabilisation au sein de l'équipe terrain

  • Façonner les outils de vente, du support de présentation aux contenus d'accompagnement, pour permettre à l'équipe de rivaliser et de gagner

  • Maintenir une présence forte sur le terrain, réaliser des audits auprès des marchands et transformer la connaissance du marché en actions concrètes

  • Définir la stratégie concurrentielle de la région et tenir les parties prenantes seniors informées de l'avancement

Vous êtes fait pour ce poste si…

  • Expérience avérée dans la direction et le développement d'équipes commerciales, incluant le coaching de consultants indépendants vers une performance durable

  • Expérience dans la construction d'une région ou d'un territoire commercial dès ses débuts, avec la structure nécessaire pour le faire évoluer

  • Solide connaissance des services aux marchands, des paiements, des systèmes de point de vente ou de la vente auprès des PME, par exemple dans l'hôtellerie ou le voyage

  • Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, avec une crédibilité reconnue pour évoluer dans des environnements multiculturels et face à des parties prenantes variées

  • Prise de décision stratégique et orientée données, avec la capacité à diriger dans l'incertitude d'un marché en forte croissance

Pourquoi rejoindre SumUp

🌎 Opportunité de travailler avec des SumUppers du monde entier sur des produits fintech à grande échelle utilisés par des millions d'entreprises, dans le cadre d'un poste de terrain couvrant la région de Toulouse. Ce poste implique des déplacements réguliers pour accompagner votre équipe sur le territoire 🌈 Engagement envers la diversité et l'inclusion : faites partie d'un environnement de travail qui valorise et promeut la diversité, favorisant un cadre inclusif où les perspectives de chacun sont respectées et accueillies 🚀 Adhésion à notre programme d'options d'achat d'actions virtuelles (VSOP) : vous détiendrez une participation dans le succès futur de SumUp 📚 Un budget annuel dédié de 2000 € pour votre développement personnel, utilisable pour assister à des conférences et/ou faire progresser votre carrière grâce à une formation complémentaire 💼 Sécurité financière : des cotisations de retraite d'entreprise qui soutiennent votre avenir à long terme 🏥 Accompagnement santé : nous prenons en charge 50 % du coût mensuel de votre assurance santé (Mutuelle et Prévoyance) 🚌 Avantages supplémentaires : nous proposons des titres restaurant (Swile) et prenons en charge vos frais de transport 🏖 Congés généreux : profitez de 25 jours de congés payés, ainsi que des jours fériés et des jours de congés spéciaux 🎉 Petits déjeuners réguliers, événements d'équipe, fêtes de bureau et activités sportives 🌴 Break4me : un mois sabbatique après 3 ans d'ancienneté 🔗 Prime de cooptation : bénéficiez de récompenses supplémentaires en recommandant des talents pour rejoindre l'équipe SumUp

À propos de SumUp

Soyez acteur d'un changement qui compte vraiment.

  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL, ainsi qu’avec les environnements Linux.
  • Vous maîtrisez les outils de gestion de versions et de développement collaboratif, notamment GitLab.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.

jobs.description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).
 
 
 
VOTRE RÔLE

Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Vous imaginez de nouveaux langages graphiques, développez des concepts créatifs avec le Brand Concepts Director et accompagnez leur déploiement sur l'ensemble des points de contact.

 

VOS MISSIONS

  • Participer au développement des concepts créatifs des projets spéciaux, collaborations et initiatives de Brand Expansion.
  • Participer au développement des identités visuelles des campagnes, collections, défilés et projets spéciaux, de leur conception à leur déclinaison.
  • Développer les systèmes graphiques, lettrages, traitements typographiques et directions artistiques associés.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description:
Diabolocom is the leading European sovereign cloud contact center (CCaaS) and customer experience management (CX) platform. It helps organizations transform customer experience by augmenting agents' capabilities through AI-human collaboration, automating routine customer interactions, and delivering personalized experiences at scale. Built on proprietary AI, private cloud, and native telecom infrastructure, the platform automates workflows, improves data quality, and empowers customer service and sales teams across every channel. 
 
Backed by more than two decades of experience and twice recognized by Frost & Sullivan for AI technology innovation and customer experience technology leadership, Diabolocom is trusted by more than 400 organizations—including BPCE, Carrefour, Nikon, and Mitsubishi—to power mission-critical customer operations in over 60 countries, helping organizations strengthen customer loyalty and accelerate growth.


About the role

To support our growth, we are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to join our HR team in Paris.

You will manage recruitment processes end-to-end, from understanding the hiring need and identifying the right sourcing strategy to interviewing candidates, managing the selection process and closing the hire.

A significant part of your activity will involve recruiting technical and highly specialized profiles, including Software Engineers, AI and Research profiles, Infrastructure experts, senior technical specialists and, depending on business needs, leadership and C-level positions.

You will work with a wide variety of stakeholders across the company: experienced hiring managers, technical experts, senior leaders and managers who may need more guidance throughout the recruitment process. Being able to adapt your approach, challenge when necessary and keep recruitment processes moving will therefore be an important part of your role.

You will join a collaborative Talent Acquisition team composed of a Talent Acquisition Team Lead, another Talent Acquisition Manager and an HR team member combining recruitment with broader HR projects, within the HR department.

We are looking for someone who is already comfortable managing recruitment independently, while remaining curious and eager to learn, develop their expertise and adopt our recruitment practices.


What you will do

  • Manage recruitment processes from A to Z, from the initial briefing with the hiring manager through sourcing, interviews, coordination of the selection process, offer management and contract signature.

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand their needs, challenge requirements when relevant and translate them into an effective recruitment and sourcing strategy.

  • Recruit across a variety of roles, with a strong focus on technical and complex profiles, including senior Software Engineers, AI/Research profiles, Infrastructure specialists, technical leadership and other hard-to-find profiles.

  • Take ownership of direct sourcing and headhunting, identifying and engaging passive candidates rather than relying primarily on inbound applications.

  • Build relevant talent pools and continuously explore new sourcing channels, tools and approaches.

  • Conduct structured interviews to assess candidates' experience, skills, motivations and potential fit with the role and environment.

  • Provide hiring managers with clear, fact-based candidate assessments and recommendations throughout the selection process.

  • Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment journey and contribute to a professional, transparent and engaging candidate experience.

  • Adapt your way of working to different stakeholders, from very experienced senior leaders to managers who require more support in structuring their recruitment process.

  • Keep our ATS and recruitment data accurate and up to date and contribute to the monitoring of key recruitment indicators.

  • Share market insights with the team and hiring managers, including candidate availability, compensation expectations, competitive dynamics and sourcing challenges.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement projects within Talent Acquisition, such as sourcing practices, interview methodologies, candidate experience, automation, documentation and recruitment processes.

  • Work closely with the rest of the Talent Acquisition and HR team, sharing knowledge, candidates, sourcing techniques and best practices.


    • What we are looking for

  • You already have a first solid experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally around 3 to 5 years, either in-house or in a recruitment agency/search environment.

  • You are able to manage a recruitment process independently from initial briefing to hire, while knowing when to ask for input or collaborate with the team.

  • You have already recruited technical and/or particularly complex profiles. Previous exposure to Software Engineering, AI/Data, Infrastructure, Research or senior technical positions would be particularly relevant.

  • You are comfortable working on senior and hard-to-find profiles and understand that some searches require persistence, creativity and a highly targeted approach.

  • Direct sourcing is part of your recruiter DNA: you are comfortable approaching passive candidates and using tools and techniques such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, talent mapping and other relevant sourcing channels.

  • You are comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels of seniority, including senior leaders and C-level executives, and can adapt your communication and level of guidance accordingly.

  • You know how to manage several recruitment processes simultaneously, prioritize effectively and maintain momentum even when working with busy stakeholders.

  • You combine autonomy with a strong team mindset: you take ownership of your searches but naturally share information, help colleagues and contribute to collective recruitment goals.

  • You are curious and eager to keep developing your recruitment expertise. You already have strong foundations, but you are still keen to learn new approaches, tools and practices.

  • You have strong interpersonal and communication skills and care about building high-quality relationships with both candidates and hiring managers.

  • Ability to build, manage and improve recruitment dashboards would be a strong plus for this role.

  • You are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.

  • Spanish would be a strong plus, as would experience recruiting across several European or international markets.


    • What's in it for you

  • A structured onboarding program to discover our product, technology, teams and culture.

  • The opportunity to work on challenging searches across Software Engineering, AI, Infrastructure, Product, business and leadership roles.

jobs.title: Remote Financial Services Agent (Independent Contractor) – Inbound Card & Account Support
jobs.description:
Set your own hours, take inbound banking card calls from home, and earn up to $350 in certification bonuses. The contract has a pool of 20,000+ hours of work available every month.

Earnings at a Glance

  • $15.00–$17.00 per hour, plus performance incentives

  • $300 certification bonus once you complete 200 productive hours

  • +$50 bonus if you certify within 6 weeks

  • Choose your own hours. Coverage runs 24/7, every day

  • Remote, U.S.-based, 1099 independent contractor

The Opportunity

Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their cards for everyday life. They might be activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. These moments matter, and you're the person who makes them go smoothly.

What the Work Involves

  • Inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions

  • Payments, transfers, and disputes, handled accurately and securely

  • Identity verification and strict security and compliance protocols on every call

  • Spotting potential fraud and helping resolve it with composure

  • Accurate documentation of every interaction

You're a Fit If You Bring

  • Clear, empathetic phone communication, even when callers are stressed

  • Care for protecting sensitive financial information

  • Comfort moving between multiple systems at once

  • Composure and problem-solving in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong plus: banking, card, financial services, or contact center experience

Your Path to Starting Work

  1. Week 1: Apply. Create your ShyftOff account and apply to the Financial Services campaign.

  2. Weeks 2–3: Screening & credentialing. Federal background check, fingerprinting, drug screening, and credential issuance.

  3. Weeks 4–5: Certification. Simulations and scored mock calls. Standards and examples of required work product are demonstrated.

  4. Week 6: Practice calls & go-live. Show that your work meets the program's accuracy and quality standards, then start choosing open hours.

Screening Cost: Please Read Before Applying

This is a federally backed program, so every contractor must complete third-party credentialing before taking live calls. As an independent contractor, you pay these providers directly:

  • Extensive federal background check

  • Fingerprinting

  • Drug screening

  • YubiKey security device (yours to keep)

Total: $299, paid to third-party providers. It's due only when you move into credentialing, not at sign-up.

What You'll Need

  • Ability to pass federal background, fingerprint, and drug screening

  • A quiet home workspace and reliable high-speed internet

  • Commitment to completing self-paced certification (about 6 weeks)

How to Apply

  1. Create your agent account at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents

  2. Apply to the Financial Services campaign from your dashboard

This is an independent contractor (1099) opportunity. You set your own schedule, work remotely, and provide your own workspace and equipment.

jobs.title: Storyteller: Freelance B2B Interviewer and Writer
jobs.location: EMEA or APAC time zones only
jobs.description:
About the Role

Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones.

Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides.

This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content.

Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment. You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative.

What You'll Do

You will:

  • Conduct virtual kickoff calls with client stakeholders to understand the goals, context, audience, and desired direction of customer reference stories.
  • Conduct virtual interviews with our clients' customers and SMEs, often involving senior-level or highly technical professionals.
  • Review project background materials and prepare for interviews in advance.
  • Use provided interview guides as a starting point while adapting questions to the conversation.
  • Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights.
  • Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input.
  • Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides.
  • Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience.
  • Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls.
  • Work collaboratively with Elite's project managers, editors, and other members of the content team throughout the development and revision process.
  • Follow client-specific processes, confidentiality requirements, and project instructions.

Job Requirements

Successful candidates must:

  • Have substantial professional writing experience, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content.
  • Have professional experience conducting interviews, preferably in journalism, B2B content, tech, publishing, corporate communications, or a related field.
  • Be located in EMEA or APAC time zones.
  • Have excellent spoken and written English and exceptional verbal communication skills.
  • Be an exceptional listener who can think on their feet and pursue useful lines of questioning in real time.
  • Be comfortable interviewing senior executives, business leaders, customers, and subject matter experts.
  • Be able to absorb unfamiliar information quickly and ask credible, informed questions about complex topics.
  • Have strong editorial judgment and be able to identify the narrative, details, and supporting evidence that will make a compelling story.
  • Be able to synthesize interviews, transcripts, background materials, and client input into a cohesive finished piece.
  • Be highly reliable, organized, responsive, and comfortable working within established processes and deadlines.
  • Have a professional remote-work setup, including reliable high-speed internet and high-quality audio/video capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

We're especially interested in candidates with one or more of the following:

  • A professional journalism background, particularly experience developing reported stories from initial research and interviews through finished copy.
  • Experience interviewing executives and subject matter experts.
  • Experience with B2B technology, enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud computing, professional services, or other complex industries.
  • Experience developing customer stories, customer reference content, case studies, thought leadership, or other long-form B2B content.
  • Experience working with or for a content, marketing, communications, or creative agency.
  • Familiarity with agency workflows in which freelancers work as part of a larger client delivery team.
  • Experience conducting interviews and developing content on behalf of major brands or enterprise organizations.
  • The ability to make interview subjects feel comfortable while keeping conversations focused and productive.

Prior agency experience is helpful but not required. We are much more interested in finding outstanding storytellers with excellent interviewing skills, writing ability, editorial judgment, curiosity, and professionalism.

Freelance Relationship

This is a freelance opportunity rather than a full-time staff position. Work will be offered based on project needs, Storyteller availability, subject-matter fit, and time zone.

Elite manages the broader client relationship, project workflow, and content production process. Freelancers work within established project parameters and compensation structures and collaborate with Elite's internal team and other content professionals to deliver the work.

Because interviews are scheduled with clients and their customers, this work requires the ability to commit to agreed-upon call times and arrive fully prepared.

About Elite Editing

Elite Editing is a woman-owned, fully remote strategic content agency based in Baltimore, Maryland. Founded in 2008, Elite began as an editing company and has grown into a full-service content partner supporting organizations with content strategy, writing, editing, marketing and sales enablement, AI implementation, and program management.

Our clients range from small businesses, publishers, agencies, universities, and thought leaders to some of the world's leading enterprise organizations. Our global network of writers, editors, interviewers, project managers, and other content professionals helps clients create high-quality content at scale.

Elite's approach is highly collaborative. We build specialized teams around our clients and integrate our processes with theirs, supporting everything from kickoff and research through SME interviewing, writing, editing, and final delivery.

We're serious about quality, but we're equally serious about being good people to work with. Our culture emphasizes trust, adaptability, collaboration, high standards, and finding a way to say "yes" to challenging work.

Who We'd Love to Hear From

You may be an especially strong fit if you've spent part of your career as a journalist and have since moved into freelance B2B, corporate, or branded content—or if you continue to work in journalism while taking on select commercial assignments.

If you know how to interview people well, recognize the story hiding within a conversation, and turn that raw material into compelling finished content, we'd like to hear from you.
